A Second Roleplay Server? To Be, Or Not To Be?

So, I've noticed that the roleplay server is full much of the time, leading me to suspect that we have people wanting to play, that can't.

My suggestion is that we setup a second roleplay server, identical to the first one, same map, same database etc etc, i.e. whatever you do in one server will affect your profile in both servers.

Anyway, allow the votes to be counted, voting will close 3 days from now!
